title: Free Drive-Thru Flu Shots (Caplet Pharmacy)
description: Starting in October, Caplet Pharmacy offers drive-thru flu shots — stay in your car and get vaccinated. Fridays 3–7 PM, Saturdays & Sundays 10 AM–3 PM. Receive a $10 Amazon gift card with your shot.

title: HCPSS Student & Parent Handbook
description: HCPSS's system-wide guide to school policies, practices, and support services — for every family, not just those connected to special education.

title: Special Education & Family Support
description: Events and workshops for HCPSS families of students with an IEP/IFSP, via the Family Support and Resource Center.

title: Little Free Library at Thunder Hill
description: A free book-sharing box in front of the school, to the left by the benches (Little Free Library charter #38247) — take a book, return a book, anytime.
